installation.updateRule: Update tracked files only while their content still matches the installed hash; preserve unowned files and block on local edits.

bootstrap.rule: Detect first, preserve existing architecture, persist only non-secret project metadata, and never reinstall a valid configured project without a reason.

selfCheck.rule: Run both after changing kit files, templates, manifest contracts, or bootstrap scripts; both must report ok: true. The repository-local Lefthook pre-commit guard runs both automatically once enabled with `npx lefthook install`.

runtime.rule: Install self-contained project helpers and manifest into each target; use the CLI update command for hash-checked upgrades.

profiles.rule: A profile describes the kind of work, not the stack. The detector records its primary match and every matched profile's definitionOfDone in project state. Profiles never install dependencies.

items.summary: General purpose work without a more specific detected profile.
items.summaryTh: งานทั่วไปที่ยังไม่ตรงกับโปรไฟล์เฉพาะ
definitionOfDone: Confirm the user goal and constraints.
Make the smallest complete change and preserve existing work.
Run relevant checks and report their actual results.

items.summary: Browser-facing applications and web user experiences.
items.summaryTh: แอปและประสบการณ์ใช้งานบนเว็บ
definitionOfDone: Verify the changed route or browser flow.
Check responsive and accessible behavior when applicable.
Run relevant tests and build checks; report any skipped verification.

items.summary: HTTP services, APIs, and backend request workflows.
items.summaryTh: บริการ HTTP, API และระบบ backend
definitionOfDone: Exercise success and error responses.
Check authorization boundaries for protected behavior.
Run service tests and report actual verification evidence.

items.summary: Scripts, command-line tools, and repeatable automation.
items.summaryTh: สคริปต์ เครื่องมือ command line และ automation
definitionOfDone: Run the command on representative inputs, including an edge case.
Check repeatability or idempotency when the task can be rerun.
Report the exact command and outcome; do not claim unrun cases passed.

items.summary: Data processing, analysis, and reproducible reporting.
items.summaryTh: การประมวลผล วิเคราะห์ และรายงานข้อมูล
definitionOfDone: Inspect input shape and handle malformed or missing values explicitly.
Verify calculations against an independent check or known case.
Keep source data unchanged and disclose assumptions and exclusions.

items.summary: Documentation, content, and operational writing work.
items.summaryTh: งานเอกสาร เนื้อหา และคู่มือปฏิบัติงาน
definitionOfDone: Use only supplied or verified facts and mark unknowns clearly.
Check instructions, links, and examples for consistency.
Review the final document for completeness and intended audience.

items.summaryTh: แอปมือถือ native และ cross-platform
definitionOfDone: Check platform-specific lifecycle and permission behavior.
Verify offline, loading, and failure states when relevant.
Run available device or simulator checks and report coverage limits.

items.summary: Infrastructure, delivery pipelines, and operational systems.
items.summaryTh: Infrastructure, pipeline และระบบปฏิบัติการ
definitionOfDone: Review the plan and blast radius before applying changes.
Validate configuration and deployment or rollback behavior.
Run relevant infrastructure checks and report unverified environments.

overlays.rule: Overlays may add domain-specific rules, but can never relax security, policy, or verification requirements.

agentPointers.rule: AGENTS.md is the single source of project instructions; agent-specific files are short pointers to it.

skills.portable: Every pack follows the open Agent Skills format, so the same directory can be copied into any harness skills directory without rewriting it.

policy.packageManagerRule: Use the package manager selected by the existing lockfile.
policy.stackRule: Detect and preserve the existing architecture. Do not force Supabase, Neon, Drizzle, Prisma, Vercel, or any other provider merely because it appears in this kit.
policy.commandPolicy: In an installed project, use node .ai-kit/bin/policy-check.mjs before commands that can mutate Git, data, cloud, containers, or remote systems; in the kit repository use node scripts/policy-check.mjs. Deny-first decisions are logged without secrets.
policy.memoryRule: Persist only non-secret decisions, lessons, and handoff context under .ai-kit/memory; current repository evidence wins.
policy.metricsRule: Record task-level session metrics when available; metrics are evidence for improvement, not claims of model quality.
